decision: Approve cover-badge canonical coverBadge and badge exceptions limited to TipCard and ArticleFeatureCover, preserving their approved APIs.

evidence.interpretation: Scoped convention and two alternative-name approvals; no global alias or thumbnail-badge widening.

convention.name: coverBadge
convention.meaning: Short non-interactive category or flag annotation rendered as a Badge over or beside a media cover or poster, outside selectable-option semantics.
convention.whenToUse: A passive poster or article cover needs a consumer-supplied category annotation beside or over its media.
convention.avoid: Selectable-option metadata, counters, interactive actions or replacing the content heading.

exceptions.reason: Preserve the explicitly approved component badge API without colliding with the unrelated thumbnail-badge canonical name.
